QuestInfo.name: Biggs's Collection of Items
QuestInfo.0: Biggs has a task for you.
QuestInfo.1: You meet Biggs in Southperry. He wants you to get him #b10 orange mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k. He doesn't look too convinced that you can do it, but it sounds like a piece of cake.
QuestInfo.2: You gathered #b10 mushroom caps and 30 blue snail shells#k for Biggs in Southperry. The weapon he gave you as a reward was pretty decent.

0.0: I'll give you something nice if you get me #b#e10#n #t4000001#s#k and #b#e30#n #t4000000#s#k! Eliminate monsters to get those items, but looking at you, I don't know if you're up to the challenge...

yes.0: Oh, you sound so confident! Let's put your money where your mouth is. Make sure to bring back #b1 #t4000001# and #b5 #t4000000#s. I'll be waiting!

no.0: You'll regret not taking a chance on such a good item!

1.0: Oh wow! You really managed to gather all the stuff I asked for! Here's an item like I promised.

yes.0: Wow, I didn't really think you would be able to gather it all. Okay, I'll give you the item as promised. I don't need it anyhow... Here you go! #l

item.0: You don't have #e10#n #b#t4000001#s#k and #e30#n#k #b#t4000000#s#k, right? Don't worry about it. I'll be here for a while.
